summary: 590 Illinois Street, a nine-story, 500-space parking garage that Pier & Point identifies as the southernmost portion of what had been tracked as one combined "block 34" shape -- split off 2026-09-22 along a visible roofline seam from the Bayfront Medical Building immediately north of it, both built under UCSF's own "Block 34 Clinical Building and Parking Garage" project.

milestones.text: Construction begins on the Illinois Street Garage portion of the Block 34 project specifically (500 spaces, nine levels), per Clark Construction's own press release: "Clark started construction on the garage portion of the development in April 2021" -- distinct from the clinical building's own Sept/Oct 2021 groundbreaking

Illinois Street Garage (590 Illinois St), 9 stories / 500 spaces, opens as part of UCSF's Block 34 Clinical Building and Parking Garage project; UCSF Real Estate's project page (which returned 403 and could not be read on 2026-09-29) is cited for it and the opening is commonly reported as May 15, 2023, but no readable source gives the month, so only the year is used here

open_questions: As of 2026-09-22, a corroborating data point: a location match of DataSF's registered business locations against this record's shape, re-run after the shape was added, shows a registration (Sentry Security Services, Inc.) whose point location falls inside it and lists '590 Illinois St' as its address -- matching the 590 Illinois St address already sourced from UCSF Real Estate's own project page, not contradicting it. The match is by location only and is never treated as confirmed on its own, so this is logged as corroboration, not an independent primary source.

SPLIT 2026-09-22: this record was previously Mission Bay block 33 (a probable, geographically-inferred identity for the WHOLE of what is now the UCSF Valley Center for Vision -- west building record -- a mistaken pairing). This was corrected: the garage is the southernmost piece of the former Mission Bay block 34 shape, not block 33. This record's shape is now the south piece of that split (the Bayfront Medical Building record holds the north piece); the split follows a visible satellite roofline seam, not a surveyed or permitted lot line, and its exact boundary should be treated as indicative rather than authoritative.
Cost of the garage alone (vs. the combined ~$335.8M clinical-building-plus-garage project figure reported elsewhere) was not found.

The April 2021 construction-start milestone comes from UCSF Real Estate's own combined project page for 'Bayfront Medical Building and Illinois Street Garage.' This is a combined-project date covering both buildings, not a garage-specific one, though Clark Construction's own press release (see milestone above) does independently corroborate April 2021 as garage-specific.

As of 2026-09-29, UCSF Real Estate's project page (the source for the 590 Illinois St address, 9 stories / 500 spaces and the May 15, 2023 opening) could not be checked, nor could its archived Wayback copy or other UCSF pages, so those details are unverified. The readable Clark Construction release confirms Block 34 with a new 9-level, 500-space garage whose construction started in April 2021, and projected delivery of the garage and clinical building in summer 2024.
